policy: No WP3 screening mode may be described as a new conserved quantity, independent first integral, involutive integral, or evidence of hidden integrability unless every required gate is PASS. A PASS would authorize only the bounded numerical claim declared by the candidate-specific evidence, not a theorem of global integrability.

artifact_record_contract.integrity: record_payload_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON after removing record_payload_sha256; the manifest separately pins the artifact file SHA-256

required_evidence.description: Qualified exact Newtonian three-body production propagation.
Qualified canonical Jacobi reduction and constrained pairwise KS kinematics.
Independent implementation of the three-body reduction and reconstruction conventions.
Qualified genuinely non-planar and chaotic three-body trajectories outside the current periodic corpus.
Independent high-precision N3BP propagation evidence beyond float64 DOP853/IAS15 agreement.
Qualified reduced or KS-lifted three-body vector field, including gauge and reconstruction dynamics.
A candidate-blind WP3 publication holdout reserved after model and thresholds are frozen.
Candidate-specific SO(3), permutation, scale, gauge, and reconstruction falsification results.
Functional-rank, Poisson-bracket, variational, and long-time drift evidence for each surviving candidate.
Independent code and external data replicate each candidate-specific result.
